notes.title: Gameplay Livestream
notes.content: Wilma's Dreams is the game I worked on for the past year during the pandemic. I did the typical indie dev story of quitting my job, moving back home, and putting my heart and soul into this project. After months of hard work, I have a game I'm proud to show off. My game is an action platformer where you survive waves to oncoming enemies and occasional bosses. There's a whole world to explore and that's exactly what we'll be doing during this event!
